title: Training and Competence Matrix
subtitle: Mbombela packhouse, status on 31 August 2026, with an induction record

blocks.p: Each row is one person and each column is a requirement from our training needs analysis for that job role. A date shows the course was completed and the certificate is on file in Section D; a **valid to** date comes from the certificate itself. **Not required** means the job role does not need it. **Booked** shows the date of a planned course. The Training Coordinator, Nokuthula Mnisi, updates the matrix every month and flags anything due within 60 days.

bullets: Jabulani Mdluli: forklift operator refresher due before 30 November 2026; booked for 19 October 2026.

Lerato Maseko: designated as a health and safety representative on 3 August 2026; representative training booked for 15 September 2026. Sibusiso Nkosi, the other representative, completed it on 10 February 2025.
Thabo Shabangu: second first aider for the dispatch shift, booked for 22 September 2026.

numbered: Our health and safety policy, and your duty to report unsafe conditions, and your right to raise a health and safety concern without being victimised.
The main hazards in the packhouse from our risk assessment: forklifts, conveyors, fruit treatment chemicals, cold rooms and manual handling.
Walkways, forklift zones, protective equipment and how to report an incident or near miss.
Emergency procedure, assembly point, fire extinguishers and first aiders on each shift.
Who the health and safety representatives are, and how the health and safety committee works.
